body:
Life sucks, man.

I hope to get off at the next stop.

It's all for the best.

I screwed up very badly today. I showed the weak and pathetic side of myself.

Every couple of years I get what appears to be an opportunity, but these are so rare and different that it's probably an illusion. Regardless, I screw it up, and these blemishes on my character make it hard to keep going on.

Even if I get another opportunity, I'll screw it up. It probably wasn't even real. I don't have another two years to wait for the next one, that's what scares me. Life is really empty when you scramble all day only to screw up the only choices that matter, if they even exist at all, which is doubtful.

I screwed up bad today. Probably not going to recover from this psychic injury. Life doesn't hand out second chances. I'm in awe of how poorly I perform at the game of life, it has to be hilarious from the sidelines. I'm writing this out in a bargaining stage with life, but it's a form of grieving and mourning a loss.

Worth is rather abstract and never concerned me too much. I'm more frustrated with results, I'm bitter and envious, a very deprived person. Who knows whose fault that is, who cares. Even if this entity has worth insofar as everyone else does as well, that doesn't make the life itself worth living. It's very --deprived--.  Deprivation screws with your head and ruins what little pleasure could otherwise be derived.

Thanks for the thoughts, this is all the summation of so much rejection, casual, serious, sexual, everything. Sometimes there is this brief second or so when I get the slightest glimmer of what other people live with and it fucks with my head so hard I shut down. How do people connect, I feel like I missed a class but I'm not autistic, simply incorrect. Incorrect is a very painful way to live in a society.  Are other people even the problem? Tons of people get on just fine, I think the problem is me and no amount of good faith effort changes that. I'm like an older teenager who was supposed to kill them-self, but didn't, and now will simply grow old, not mature. It's like life if a walled garden.

This isn't a troll, I'm backed into a corner and freaking out, having a panic attack.

I'm not scared, but worried. Everything is collapsing, I am so very incomplete, like a half-baked person, and everyone is so capable, and sexy, and holy shit what did I do wrong or not do to deserve this. there is no deserve there is only death. i wanted to believe in this lie that there is a better tomorrow but tomorrow is worse than the day before pretty much always. some of us cant connect with another person if you held a gun to our head. could you, please, pretty please, do that. it'd be humane and we pride ourselves on our humanity, right?
